description: Land Title Settlement Department - Uduwawala, Harispaththuwa D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320319
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land titles for specific parcels (Nos. 68, 74, 81, 104, and 92) in Uduwawala, Kandy District. It includes detailed land parcel information, ownership details, and legal determinations regarding land titles, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
